import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
a=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0108.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&((R-B)>15)
def fit(lo,hi):
    P=[]
    for u in range(lo,hi):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        if not len(c) or c.min()<=258: continue
        v=int(c.min()); D=396.8/(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
        P.append([L,D])
    if len(P)<6: return None
    A=np.array(P); c=A.mean(0); Z=A-c
    _,_,V=np.linalg.svd(Z); d=V[0]; n=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])
    return round(abs(n@c),4), round(float(np.abs(Z@n).std()),4), len(P), round(math.degrees(math.atan2(d[0],d[1])),2)
tops={}
for u in range(512):
    c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
    if len(c) and c.min()>258: tops[u]=int(c.min())
mn=min(tops.values()); cand=[u for u in tops if tops[u]==mn]
print('corner v',mn,cand)
print('LEFT ',fit(0,cand[0]-4))
print('RIGHT',fit(cand[-1]+5,512))
cx,cy,h=-0.511,1.500,135.0
hh=math.radians(h); F=(math.sin(hh),math.cos(hh)); Rt=(math.cos(hh),-math.sin(hh))
br=(R>70)&(R<190)&((R-B)>40)&(G<R-15)&(B<120)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(br)
print('brown u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max(),'n',len(ys))
for u in range(xs.min(),xs.max()+1,8):
    c=np.nonzero(br[:,u])[0]
    if not len(c): continue
    v=int(c.max())
    D=396.8/(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    print(' u',u,'vbot',v,'-> (%.2f,%.2f)'%(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0], cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1]))
EOF
